newsitem.title: USA: Senate confirms Richardson as U.N. ambassador.
newsitem.headline: Senate confirms Richardson as U.N. ambassador.

text.p: The Senate on Tuesday confirmed Democratic Representative Bill Richardson of New Mexico as U.S. ambassador to the United Nations.

The 100-0 vote took place after only a few minutes of debate during which Republicans voiced concern about an administration plan to seek nearly $1 billion to pay off U.S. arrears to the United Nations.
Republicans, including Senate Foreign Relations Committee Chairman Jesse Helms, are demanding that payment of arrears be linked to specific actions to reform the world body.

Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, referring to the payment of arrears, told the House International Relations Committee earlier Tuesday: "Our continued leadership at the U.N. depends upon it. Our principles require it. Our budget allows it. And our interests demand it."
